name: Remotion
free_plan_limits: Free for individuals and for-profit companies up to 3 employees
usage_note: Creators $25 per seat a month; Automators $0.01 per render, $100 a month minimum
since_note: Launched on Product Hunt 9 February 2021 (Product Hunt).
notes: Source-available, not open source. Larger companies pay. Enterprise starts at $500 a month. Pricing comes from search results on remotion.dev pages that did not fully agree; confirm before buying.

name: FFmpeg
best_for: Converting and cutting video by command
notes: Command-line tools and libraries, no editor. You host and run it yourself. About page says free software but names no license; open-source status is well known.

name: HyperFrames
since_note: Open-sourced by HeyGen in 2026 (project directory lists March 2026; press coverage April to July 2026).
best_for: Turning HTML pages into MP4 video
notes: HeyGen's HTML-to-video tool, Apache 2.0 per secondary sources; not checked on the official repo. You pay for your own servers. HeyGen's hosted rendering has separate pricing, not found.

name: Creatomate
free_plan_limits: 50 credits, no time limit, renders capped at 480p
usage_note: 2,000 credits a month; 1 credit per image, about 289 Shorts
since_note: Company founded 2020; video API launched publicly 5 December 2022 (Product Hunt).
best_for: Template videos from n8n or Make
notes: Yearly is $540 on Essential (about 17% less). Includes API access and a template editor. n8n, Make and Zapier supported.

name: JSON2Video
usage_note: 1 credit per second of rendered video
best_for: Making videos from a JSON recipe
notes: Hobby is $16.63 a month billed yearly ($199.50). Professional is $49.95 monthly or $33.30 yearly. 30-minute max video. n8n and Make not mentioned on the page.

name: Shotstack
free_plan_limits: Free sandbox plus 10 credits valid 30 days
usage_note: 250 render minutes a month on Starter (about 15.6 cents a minute)
since_note: Founded 2020 by Jeff Shillitto and Derk Zomer (FEED magazine interview); PitchBook and SourceForge list 2019.
notes: Pay as you go is $10 once for 50 minutes. Pro $99 for 750 minutes. Make, Zapier and n8n integrations on every plan. AI generation is charged per use.
